adapters.exportDuty: Nothing durable lives in KV: last-good app config, the public JWKS document, short-lived session-revocation records and rate counters — every one rebuildable from its source (the config documents, the identity server, a fresh sign-out). The nightly export still copies each namespace to R2 (services/platform/src/backup/index.ts). Cannot move: nothing that matters — KV has no bulk export, so a switch REBUILDS on the target rather than copying.

c8Seam.why: tooling/capability-register.json records Cloudflare's C-8 seam as the client's ConfigTransport (the config the apps fetch). KV is one of several Cloudflare surfaces now behind its own port; the vendor's C-8 row is re-seated when its last surface, D1, is ported.

adapters.exportDuty: A test double: a Map with TTL that lives for one test. Nothing to export.

pending.case: the whole suite against the real binding: every Worker suite runs on Node under plain vitest (services/*/vitest.config.ts), not on workerd — no Miniflare, no @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers — so the binding never meets the suite in CI; the structural proof is tsc over ports/adapters/cloudflare.ts

_why: CONFIG_KV, JWKS_CACHE, SESSION_REVOKED and SIGNUPS are declared as KvStore in every Worker's `interface Env`, and every handler — the auth plumbing in services/_shared/src/auth-middleware.ts included — takes a KvStore. The binding satisfies it STRUCTURALLY; cloudflareKv is the identity, kept as the compile-time proof (tsc reds the day the binding and the port drift). assert-ports limb 12 refuses a KVNamespace type anywhere else under services/*/src.

L2 claimed, L2 target: the selection is by environment (wrangler binds the namespace in live and sandbox; the memory fake serves tests), no caller imports an adapter, and one non-fake adapter is live. L3 would need a second REAL store and a switch runbook, and nothing durable lives here to justify one (tooling/capability-register.json cloudflare.exitPlan: "Deliberately kept: nothing durable lives in KV").
The conformance suite runs against the memory fake; against the binding it is PENDING, because no Worker suite runs on workerd. A missing key is null, not a throw; list pages; a TTL expires.
